owner_text: Hi, quick one: what does this cost? I have a meeting in ten minutes.
Odalys Ferreira, Quarry Lane Studio. I own it.
It's a salon sort of place: hair, nails, facials. Two sites, eleven staff.
Booked by phone, through the booking site, or Instagram messages. About 40 a day.
No wait, 125 a week, that's what the diary says.
125 a week. Forty was my busiest Friday.
Four minutes each, plus two typing.
The booking site, the appointment book, a shared spreadsheet.
Take the booking, enter it in the book, send a reminder text, welcome the client, take payment. Discounts over 15 percent need me.
No-shows, double bookings, buried Instagram messages. So clients booked twice, and messages unanswered.
Booking intake, reminder texts, message sorting; mainly I want to grow. CSV download from the booking site. Client phone numbers and skin allergy notes, yes. Nothing urgent.
About 3000 USD. No idea when to start.
